scope: Independent read-only mission/deliverable/completion review; writes restricted to analysis-local/final-audit/completion.

observations.provenance_claims: Reviewed prose correctly distinguishes archive byte match, unsigned publisher authenticity and mutable timestamps; external historical facts not re-established by this audit.
observations.mission_completion_boundary: Mission's static as-far-as-evidence-permits deliverables are present. Subsequent requested dynamic Windows,hardware,account and all-target completion is not achieved.

findings.finding: No configured approved Windows guest, no remote console access/new owner hardware receipt, and no supplied approved exact package. The requested actual tests cannot be truthfully completed from static bytes.
findings.action: Keep every behavioral test BLOCKED until the owner supplies those prerequisites and the relevant execution approval; do not fabricate success.

findings.finding: At audited snapshot W09 JSON still describes synthetic valid signatures although prose correctly requires a genuine publisher-signed positive fixture.
findings.action: Make JSON match prose and preserve fixture/key/origin/hash blocker. Analyst-key success cannot establish target-key acceptance.

findings.finding: W10/W11 require Mesa hash even for actual Windows launcher tests. Those desktop tests should record the actual selected graphics/native providers, which need not include Xbox's Mesa adaptation.
findings.action: Require applicable desktop provider identity/hashes; keep Mesa mandatory only where selected by the tested package.

findings.finding: At audited snapshot the receipt checker consumes cases only and does not enforce target_plans, exact target tuple, predecessor receipt linkage or complete56-target/four-runtime coverage.
findings.action: Either explicitly limit it to format/reference integrity and separately review coverage, or add exact tuple/required-gate/aggregate enforcement. A validator exit0 never independently confirms execution.

findings.finding: Only top-level fields are allowlisted; nested arbitrary fields are accepted. The tool does not automatically prove attachments or receipts contain no credentials.
findings.action: Use manual redaction review and say so; consider nested schema allowlists. Never present validator success as privacy certification.

findings.finding: The approved source retains1.12.2 Forge loader_version='selected', not a resolved exact Forge release. It also declares the legacy provider absent.
findings.action: Preserve the approved catalog row; separately record unresolved loader-version and absent-provider blockers. Require actual resolved version/profile/artifact hashes before any execution verdict.

findings.finding: X03-X08 specify useful probe outcomes but no independently built diagnostic package/probe source is supplied at the audited snapshot. The main APPX alone is not evidence that these probes exist.
findings.action: List separately approved diagnostic source/build/package as prerequisites; source-only preparation remains feasible but hardware probe outcomes stay blocked.

findings.finding: Generated analyst Python bytecode appeared inside the publication folder while the new receipt checker was being inspected.
findings.action: Exclude generated cache from publication, suppress future cache writes and regenerate publication hashes after all final edits. This is analyst cache, not a recovered proprietary binary.

feasible_static_remaining: Prepare independently written source-only probe specification/fixtures in a separate approved research area, without changing production or target trust keys
Retain exact public metadata/profile/artifact hashes for every loader target before owner execution
Finalize reproducible receipt indexing and publication hashes
unavailable_required_evidence: Explicit target execution approval tied to that guest
Contemporaneous historical acquisition/update evidence or independently authenticated publisher release identity

gate_audit.action: Verify guest isolation and hashes before launching
remaining_prerequisites: Owner-approved disposable Windows guest and explicit isolation configuration
Fixed archived installer identity; no target execution for this preliminary gate
acceptance_evidence: Guest OS/build and disposable account class
Isolation settings and approved network-disabled mode
SHA256 equal to archived installer research identity

gate_audit.action: Snapshot guest, run installer offline into guest-only location
remaining_prerequisites: Explicit installer-execution approval in disposable guest
acceptance_evidence: Installer exit/outcome and installation file/shortcut/config inventory
Comparison with all770 statically decoded payload records, explaining conditional files

gate_audit.action: Launch archived launcher offline
acceptance_evidence: Observed wrapper/bootstrap/launcher process identities and sanitized JVM properties
Missing-cache/error/cancellation behavior and absence of successful network calls

gate_audit.action: Start from empty guest game cache; approve narrowly scoped public network downloads
remaining_prerequisites: Separately approved narrowly scoped guest networking and public endpoint capture
Pinned empty-cache version and download metadata
acceptance_evidence: Catalog/version/client/library/native/asset/runtime request sequence with response status,size,hash,destination
No sign-in or authentication capture

gate_audit.action: Compare warm-cache versus empty-cache preparation
remaining_prerequisites: Hash-bound valid/missing/corrupt guest fixture copies; host files excluded
acceptance_evidence: Compared checked/reused/downloaded/hash-failure counts
All promoted files match expected hashes; corrupt files do not count as completed

gate_audit.action: Interrupt transfer and resume using guest snapshot/test copies
remaining_prerequisites: Pinned interrupt/resume fixture and documented interruption points
acceptance_evidence: Partial length,Range/206 behavior,retry timing and final content hash
No truncated output marked installed; cancellation state documented

gate_audit.action: Simulate full/readonly guest test volume and cancellation
remaining_prerequisites: Disposable guest test volume and checkpoint
acceptance_evidence: Disk-full/read-only/cancellation error and recoverable state
No false success, host modification or implicit uninstaller execution

gate_audit.action: Exercise configuration/profile migration with synthetic empty accounts only
acceptance_evidence: Before/after configuration,backup/temp/replace observations
Restart persistence and error recovery; no token/account values

gate_audit.action: Isolated synthetic update fixtures with valid/invalid/truncated signatures
remaining_prerequisites: Retained genuine publisher-signed positive metadata fixture with independent origin,key identity and original hash
Hash-bound corrupted/truncated variants; integration route without changing target key
acceptance_evidence: Actual original-key positive acceptance
Actual malformed/signature-failure rejection
Failure receipts identify exact fixture and target versions

gate_audit.action: Test each loader path identified from exact metadata
remaining_prerequisites: Enumerated exact upstream loader versions and metadata/artifact identities
acceptance_evidence: Separate Fabric/Forge branches and exact artifact identities
Actual processor input/output and launch-plan results where that path exists
Actual selected Windows native/graphics provider identity; no assumed Mesa dependency

gate_audit.action: Game process/exit/error controls after explicit game-execution approval
remaining_prerequisites: Existing legitimate account requirements met by owner where needed
acceptance_evidence: Actual JVM major/sanitized arguments,process exit/error/UI restoration
Applicable desktop graphics/native provider hashes

gate_audit.action: Optional owner-controlled account tests, separately authorized
remaining_prerequisites: Owner performs account actions without sharing credentials or raw authenticated traffic
acceptance_evidence: Sanitized Microsoft/XBL/XSTS/Minecraft/ownership/profile stage outcomes
Refresh/signout/failure boundaries where authorized; no tokens or account identifiers

gate_audit.action: Owner installs approved exact package; record identity/build/dependencies
remaining_prerequisites: Exact approved signed package and dependencies
Owner-operated real Series X Developer Mode deployment/access
acceptance_evidence: Console OS/build,package identity/version/hash and activation result
Exact executable/JVM/shim/Mesa identities

gate_audit.action: Run outside debugger and measure memory/CPU/GPU during launcher idle/load
remaining_prerequisites: Owner capture outside debugger with declared workload/duration
acceptance_evidence: Measured idle/load memory/CPU/GPU sample series and peak
Actual package resource budget; no generic limit inference

gate_audit.action: Synthetic JVM invocation for each current/java21/java17/legacy package
remaining_prerequisites: Owner-operated Series X and exact package
acceptance_evidence: One actual invocation result for each of four runtime families
Requested/accepted JNI version,Java major,exception and synthetic entrypoint outcome
No desktop runtime substitution

gate_audit.action: Synthetic filesystem/thread/ZIPFS tests using app-local data
remaining_prerequisites: Owner-operated Series X app-local test data
acceptance_evidence: Actual read/write/rename/thread/ZIPFS probe results
Allowed-root identities and errors; no broad-file grant assumption

gate_audit.action: JNI/native load probe against exact packaged/selected modules
remaining_prerequisites: Selected x64 native files plus standard/delay/dynamic dependency requirements
acceptance_evidence: Actual module load and required symbol resolution per selected module
Full sanitized loader/JNI errors and module identities

gate_audit.action: Graphics probe: context version/profile/extensions, shader compile/link, draw/present
remaining_prerequisites: Exact graphics probe/package and per-target required GL capability list
acceptance_evidence: Context/profile/extensions,shader compile/link results
Actual draw/present frame receipt plus expected image/counters
Behavior of required extension queries

gate_audit.action: Controller, keyboard, pointer/focus/disconnect/reconnect
remaining_prerequisites: Owner-attached controller/keyboard/pointer and explicit expected mapping/event plan
acceptance_evidence: Button/axis/pointer/focus and disconnect/reconnect observations
Hat/mapping/HWND-dependent consumer results separately identified

gate_audit.action: Audio probe including device loss
remaining_prerequisites: Owner-controlled output/device-loss setup; capture permission only if that case is authorized
acceptance_evidence: Measured playback,latency and error/device-loss recovery
Capture-policy result only when actually exercised

gate_audit.action: Suspend/resume and terminate/relaunch
remaining_prerequisites: Exact package and owner-operated lifecycle transitions
Known synthetic or legitimately owned saved-state baseline
acceptance_evidence: Suspend/resume/terminate/relaunch markers
Resource,graphics,audio,input,persistence and repeat-JVM outcomes

gate_audit.action: Download/repair of approved target with existing account gate respected
acceptance_evidence: Actual checked/reused/downloaded/hash-failure counts and promoted-file identities
Failure/cancellation/repair state; gate retained

gate_audit.action: Owner-authorized legitimate owned target launch
remaining_prerequisites: Owner-approved account use with legitimate entitlement/profile
Prior package/runtime/native/graphics gates satisfied for that tuple
acceptance_evidence: Actual sanitized ownership/profile stage results
Actual title/world/gameplay observation and exact tuple/resource/error receipt

gate_audit.action: Repeat per catalog row and regression profile
remaining_prerequisites: Resolved exact loader version and package/artifacts per row
Independent owner observations for applicable X01-X13 gates; no source label promotion
acceptance_evidence: One indexed PASSED/FAILED/BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE result for each56 target ID
Hash-bound predecessor receipts linked to exact package/runtime tuple
Absent legacy providers and unresolved JNI families stay unsupported/blocked

gate_audit.action: Phase 5F.2 UI regression
remaining_prerequisites: Owner-operated controller/UI and account-gated test states
acceptance_evidence: Installed/Installed-Off restart persistence,no duplicate install,active-profile state
Failed download/account boundary behavior; no extrapolation from historical report
